paragraphs: Hill or Ocean? Posted by Lily. Next month, the Explorers can choose a trip. On Thursday, Teacher Kim showed us two photos, a green hill and a blue ocean. Everyone said, "Both are great!" So I made a list to compare them. Please read it, and then vote.

The Hill. The hill is higher than our school. From far away, it looks like a pyramid. You walk up a path, and you see a lot of land from the top. At the top, the wind is cool. There are more insects on the hill than at the ocean. Mia likes this, because she wants to take photos of butterflies. The hill is quieter than the ocean, so you can hear the birds. It is cooler under the trees than on the sand. You need good shoes for the path.

The Ocean. The ocean is much bigger than the hill. It is bigger than all the land on the Earth. At the ocean, you can swim and play volleyball on the sand. The sand is hotter than the grass, so wear shoes. The view is very wide, and you can see boats. Leo wants to build a big pyramid of sand. He says, "Sand is easier than stones." The land near the ocean is poor, so only small plants grow there. There are not as many trees as on the hill. The ocean is also noisier, because the waves are always loud.

Which trip is better, the hill or the ocean? Mia votes for the hill, but Leo votes for the ocean. I like the view from the top of a hill. I also like to swim, so I cannot decide. We can visit only one place. Teacher Kim will count the votes on Thursday. Write your vote in a message under this post!
